mapper.select: SELECT t1.JC_JOIN AS jcJoin , t1.ymd AS ymd , t1.CY_GB AS cyGb , t1.balh_co AS balhCo , t1.JM_NM AS jmNm , t1.JM_NM AS xxBalhCo , t1.jg_tr_co_cd AS trCoCd , t1.jg_tr_co_nm AS xxTrCoCd , t1.START_YMD AS startYmd , t1.END_YMD AS endYmd , t1.SJ_YMD AS sjYmd , t1.NABIB_YMD AS nabibYmd , t1.TOT_B_JUSU AS totBJusu , t1.TOT_G_JUSU AS totGJusu , t1.tot_g_danga AS totGDanga , t1.TOT_G_AEK AS totGAek , t1.cy_jm_cd AS cyJmCd , t1.sj_jm_cd AS sjJmCd , t1.susu_per AS susuPer , t1.jkm_per AS jkmPer , t1.competition_rate AS competitionRate , t1.BIGO AS bigo , t1.UPD_USER AS updUser , f_jm_nm('', t1.cy_jm_cd) AS xxCyJmCd , f_jm_nm('', t1.sj_jm_cd) AS xxSjJmCd , CASE WHEN t1.balh_co IS NULL OR ((t1.start_ymd IS NULL OR t1.start_ymd < aa.hyun_ymd) AND (NVL(t1.sj_ymd, aa.hyun_ymd + 1) > aa.hyun_ymd)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pVisible FROM SZX0AA aa , SJG1JC t1 WHERE aa.corp_gr = #{corpGr} ORDER BY t1.ymd DESC, t1.jm_nm ASC, t1.balh_co ASC
SELECT NVL(f_n0(seqval('join_seq')), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || LPAD(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(jc_join, 9))), 0) + 1, 2, '0')) FROM SJG1JC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SJG1JC ( JC_JOIN, ymd, CY_GB, balh_co, JM_NM, jg_tr_co_cd, jg_tr_co_nm, START_YMD, END_YMD, SJ_YMD, NABIB_YMD, TOT_B_JUSU, TOT_G_JUSU, tot_g_danga, TOT_G_AEK, cy_jm_cd, sj_jm_cd, susu_per, jkm_per, competition_rate, BIGO, UPD_USER ) VALUES ( #{jcJoin}, #{ymd}, #{cyGb}, #{balhCo}, #{jmNm}, #{trCoCd}, #{xxTrCoCd}, #{startYmd}, #{endYmd}, #{sjYmd}, #{nabibYmd}, #{totBJusu}, #{totGJusu}, #{totGDanga}, #{totGAek}, #{cyJmCd}, #{sjJmCd}, #{susuPer}, #{jkmPer}, #{competitionRate}, #{bigo}, #{updUser} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SJG1FC WHERE JC_JOIN = #{jcJoin}

SELECT tr.corp_gr AS corpGr , TR.JC_JOIN AS jcJoin , tr.jg_tr_co_cd AS jgTrCoCd , tr.sc_YMD AS scYmd , tr.sc_JUSU AS scJusu , tr.sc_DANGA AS scDanga , tr.sc_AEK AS scAek , tr.sc_USER AS scUser , tr.cy_YMD AS cyYmd , tr.cy_JUSU AS cyJusu , tr.cy_DANGA AS cyDanga , tr.cy_AEK AS cyAek , tr.cy_JKM AS cyJkm , tr.cy_USER AS cyUser , tr.lock_end AS lockEnd , tr.nabib_ymd AS nabibYmd , tr.cy_type AS cyType , tr.BIGO AS bigo , T1.JC_JOIN AS jcJcJoin , t1.ymd AS ymd , t1.balh_co AS balhCo , t1.jg_tr_co_cd AS sjg1jcJgTrCoCd , t1.jg_tr_co_nm AS jgTrCoNm , t1.JM_NM AS jmNm , f_balh_nm(#{corpGr}, t1.balh_co) AS xxBalhCo , t1.cy_GB AS cyGb , t1.sj_ymd AS sjYmd , t1.sj_jm_cd AS sjJmCd , t1.tot_g_danga AS totGDanga , t1.start_ymd AS startYmd , t1.end_ymd AS endYmd , t1.susu_per AS susuPer , t1.jkm_per AS jkmPer , t1.nabib_ymd AS jcNabibYmd , t1.bigo AS jcBigo , CASE WHEN t1.nabib_ymd > aa.hyun_ymd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pVisible FROM SZX0AA aa , SJG1JC t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN sjg1jc_tr tr ON tr.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND tr.JC_JOIN = t1.JC_JOIN WHERE aa.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.ymd <= aa.GIJUNGA_YMD AND t1.balh_co IS NOT NULL AND (t1.nabib_ymd >= aa.hyun_ymd OR tr.jc_join IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY t1.ymd DESC, t1.jm_nm ASC, t1.sj_jm_cd ASC

SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , t1.JC_JOIN AS jcJoin , t1.jg_tr_co_cd AS jgTrCoCd , t1.FUND_CD AS fundCd , gi.SUN_JASAN_AEK AS sunJasanAek , t1.SC_JUSU AS scJusu , t1.SC_AEK AS scAek , t1.CY_JUSU AS cyJusu , t1.CY_AEK AS cyAek , t1.CY_JKM AS cyJkm , t1.CY_SUSU AS cySusu , NVL(t1.CY_AEK, 0) + NVL(t1.CY_SUSU, 0) - NVL(t1.CY_JKM, 0) AS cyGyuljeAek , t1.lock_end AS lockEnd , t1.f47_ymd AS f47Ymd , f_fund_nm(t1.corp_gr, t1.fund_cd) AS fundNm , f_fund_nm(t1.corp_gr, t1.fund_cd) AS xxFundCd , CASE WHEN tr.nabib_ymd >= #{workDate} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pVisible FROM sjg1fc t1 , sjg1jc tr , skt0gi gi WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.JC_JOIN = #{jcJoin} AND t1.jg_tr_co_cd = #{jgTrCoCd} AND tr.jc_join = t1.jc_join AND tr.jg_tr_co_cd = t1.jg_tr_co_cd AND gi.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND gi.YMD = #{ymd} - 1 AND gi.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD ORDER BY t1.fund_cd ASC

SELECT tr.CORP_GR AS corpGr , t1.YMD AS ymd , t1.JC_JOIN AS jcJoin , t1.sj_JM_CD AS sjJmCd , tr.JG_TR_CO_CD AS jgTrCoCd , t1.JM_NM AS jmNm , t1.CY_GB AS cyGb , tr.sc_ymd AS scYmd , tr.SC_JUSU AS scJusu , tr.SC_DANGA AS scDanga , tr.CY_JUSU AS cyJusu , tr.CY_DANGA AS cyDanga , tr.BIGO AS bigo , tr.lock_end AS lockEnd , tr.CY_YMD AS cyYmd , tr.NABIB_YMD AS nabibYmd FROM sjg1jc t1 , sjg1jc_tr tr WHERE tr.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND tr.jc_join = t1.jc_join AND tr.cy_jusu > 0 ORDER BY t1.ymd DESC, t1.jm_nm ASC, t1.sj_jm_cd ASC
